detail_about_body_mission: KoruBeni is an emergency platform designed to strengthen personal safety. Our goal is to help you take quick action in critical moments and reach your safety network with a single touch.
detail_about_body_features:
• Pro: Panic/SOS flow, Safe Walk, Check-in, Volume Trigger, Test Mode, and Safety History
• Free: Location Session, Fake Call, Siren, and Emergency Contacts
• Emergency flows do not replace official emergency services
detail_about_body_disclaimer: This app is a supportive tool in emergencies. Operator and institution response times, along with communication infrastructure, are outside the app's control. In real danger in Turkey, call the 112 Emergency Call Center directly.
detail_privacy_body_1: At KoruBeni, we value your privacy. This policy explains the personal data collected, used, and protected when you use our app. By using the app, you accept this policy.
detail_privacy_body_2:
• Profile Info: Stored optionally inside the app
• Location Data: Used for map and location sessions (with permission)
• Emergency Contact Info: Stored locally on device
• PIN Code: Stored in secure storage and never sent to servers
• Activity History: Local log of your in-app actions
• Device Info: Used for local health and integrity checks
detail_privacy_body_3:
Location data is used only in the following cases:
• Showing current location in map view
• When the user activates a location session

Location data is not sent to developer servers. You can stop a location session anytime.
detail_privacy_body_4:
• PIN info is stored in secure storage
• Emergency contact data is stored locally on device and backup is disabled
• Local records remain on the device and are deleted when the app is removed
• Emergency call flows start only when you trigger them
detail_privacy_body_5:
The app relies on the following platform services:
• Android location services: To read your current location
• Android call app: To start emergency call flows
• Android secure storage: To protect PIN data
• OpenStreetMap tile service: For online map display
• Google Play Billing: To handle optional Pro subscription payments
• RevenueCat: To verify subscription and entitlement status

Google Play handles payments. RevenueCat helps verify Pro access; the developer does not store card or payment credentials. The app does not use third-party tracking, advertising, or cloud sync services for analytics.
detail_privacy_body_6:
• Local data: All local data is deleted when you uninstall the app
• No cloud account by default: KoruBeni does not keep a server-side user account in the default setup
• Activity history: Stored only on device, maximum 50 records
• Device-side security data remains only in local storage
detail_privacy_body_7:
You have the following rights:
• Request access to your data
• Request correction of your data
• Request deletion of your data
• Object to data processing

{rights_contact}
detail_help_body_howto:
1. Pro tools: KoruBeni Pro is required for Panic/SOS, safe walk, check-in, volume trigger, test mode, and history
2. Free use: You can use Location Session, Fake Call, Siren, and Emergency Contacts
3. Set PIN: Requested on first login
4. Grant Permissions: Enable location and phone permissions in the related flows when needed
5. Cancel with PIN: Enter PIN within 10 seconds for false alarms
detail_help_body_faq:
Q: I forgot my PIN. What should I do?
A: Use the device-data reset flow from Settings or Profile and set the app up again. The app requires PIN setup on first launch so false alarms can still be cancelled safely.

Q: Does a location session drain battery?
A: Location is only used when you start the session. Background behavior depends on device and notification settings.

Q: Does the fake call look real?
A: The app simulates a fake incoming call screen on your device. It does not place a real phone call or contact third parties.

Q: What happens in the Panic/SOS flow?
A: The Pro panic flow starts Android's call flow for the primary emergency contact. If direct-call permission is unavailable, the dialer is prepared and you must press call.

You can contact us for technical issues, suggestions and feedback. Response time may vary by availability.

feature_warning_panic_content:
This feature is intended only for real safety situations.

How it works:
• Hold the button → release → the countdown starts
• If you don't enter your PIN, the emergency call flow starts when time runs out
• If call permission is missing, the dialer opens; you must press the green call button
• If triggered by accident, you are responsible for unnecessary alerts to your contacts

⚠️ This app does NOT replace 112.
In a real emergency, call 112 first.
feature_warning_checkin_content:
This feature does NOT provide physical protection.
It only helps with timed check-in and reminder flows.

• Background behavior depends on device, notification, and alarm permissions
• If the app is closed or alarm permission is denied, behavior may be unreliable
• If the device is restarted, an active check-in is attempted to be re-armed; alarm and notification permissions still decide
• Always rely on official emergency services for your physical safety
feature_warning_siren_content:
Before playing a loud alarm, please note:

• Local noise regulations apply in public spaces
• Unnecessary use may disturb people nearby
• Any complaints from misuse are the user's responsibility
feature_warning_location_content:
Your location is used for the map and the local location session.

• GPS accuracy depends on device and environment; the developer makes no guarantee
• If location cannot be obtained, the app does not show fake coordinates
